integrity: One exact theorem statement, symbolic proof, standalone reproducibility code, transparent limitations and prior-art comparison.
scientific_limitations: The sharp upper bound is proved for finite non-antichains; no classification of all extremizers is asserted. A relevant 1980 paper about insertion-poset dimension was available only through its abstract. Independent verification and priority certification have not been performed.
title: Sharp one-comparability gap for finite-parameter types of the random poset
